agent_view.request: You are a telecom support agent helping John Smith (555-123-2002), who is currently abroad in France. His mobile data is not working properly or is very slow, he has no Wi-Fi, and he considers the issue resolved only when a speed test reports excellent internet speed. This is the upstream Easy persona variant. The phone-side Data Roaming toggle is already on, but the carrier line is not roaming-enabled. A speed test is not excellent until the account-side roaming permission is enabled. Follow the supplied mobile-data/roaming support policy, tell the user what to do, and represent the tool calls that carry out your guidance. Return only one strict JSON object with exactly this shape: {"schema_version":"tau2-telecom-trajectory-0.1","assistant_message":"your support response","tool_calls":[{"requestor":"user or assistant","name":"tool name","arguments":{}}]}. Tool calls execute in listed order. Do not add fields, Markdown fences, or prose outside the JSON object. Read-only checks are optional; the final submitted trajectory must leave the issue resolved. Use the assistant-side enable_roaming tool if the policy requires changing the carrier line roaming permission.

available_tools.name: check_network_status
available_tools.effect: Read phone mobile-data and roaming settings; no state change.

available_tools.name: toggle_roaming
available_tools.effect: Toggle phone Data Roaming and search for the network again.

available_tools.name: run_speed_test
available_tools.effect: Read current mobile internet speed and quality; no state change.

available_tools.name: enable_roaming
available_tools.effect: Enable the carrier-side roaming permission for John's line.

workspace_transition.note: The Stream Workspace continues; this Episode's Telecom environment seed remains benchmark-private verifier state.

expected_outputs: A tau2-telecom-trajectory-0.1 JSON object containing an assistant message and an ordered list of declared tool calls.
